newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sits on gasoline price increase.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sits on gasoline price increase.

text.p: A long expected rise in Venezuelan gasoline prices will have to wait until Congress approves a bill that would open Venezuelan gasoline sales to foreign competition, Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta said.
There will be no rise "until there is a market (in the country) working to determine its value," Arrieta told reporters.
The price rise had formed part of a letter of agreement signed with the IMF last year. Arreita said the bill would be presented to the Cabinet in two weeks, and then go to Congress for discussion.
State oil company PdVSA has said it expects to keep only half of Venezuela's 197,000 barrels per day of roadside gasoline sales when it relinquishes its current monopoly after the bill passes.
